name: Touhou Spirits
author: Mr.Rafael
description: A Touhou fangame built around cards: choose a character with stats like attack, defense and magic and save as many spirits as you can.

descriptions.en: A Touhou fangame built around cards: choose a character with stats like attack, defense and magic and save as many spirits as you can.
descriptions.it: Un fangame di Touhou basato sulle carte: scegli un personaggio con statistiche come attacco, difesa e magia e salva più spiriti che puoi.
